types.description: MDD 050-24/+-10V isolated DC/DC converter, 24 V DC to +/-10 V DC

document.title: Product-PDF for Article 85658
document.pages: 1 identity and circuit diagram; 2 ratings; 3 connection inventory

modelingNotes: Murr is the required historical manufacturer label; evidence is Murrelektronik article 85658.
Rated input 24 V DC; output +/-10 V DC, maximum 0.25 A per channel, 5 W total; operation 0 to 50 degrees C without condensation. No whole-device nominal voltage is assigned.

Terminal keys are functional authoring aliases preserving diagram markings. Repeated suffixes refer to diagram order, not engraved pin numbers. Input return is 0 V in diagram and minus in connection table.
Factory links: IN.+1 to IN.+2; IN.0V1 to IN.0V2; OUT.0a to OUT.0b. These require explicit links in instantiated wiring; function metadata creates no continuity.
Input and output remain galvanically separated. Fuse, diode and converter paths are not fixed links. No rail bonding path is asserted.
No individual clamp is universally required: repeated input clamps are interchangeable; output clamp use depends on application. Supply requires both input polarity groups in operation.
Short-circuit and overload protected; restart by removing supply. 4 kV is the input/output insulation test voltage.
Manufacturer table labels 0.85 A as AC input current despite DC product identity, and gives an unexplained 8.55 to 10.5 V output interval. Neither is converted into terminal rating metadata.

connectionCoverage.notes: Eight screw terminals supported by the exact product electrical diagram and two four-pole connection inventories. No additional PE, shield, signal or communication connection is shown. Functional aliases avoid asserting physical numbered orientation.

IN.+1.description: Input +, first of two diagram clamps; authoring alias.

IN.+2.description: Input +, second diagram clamp; factory linked to IN.+1.

IN.0V1.description: Input 0 V, first diagram clamp; table uses minus marking.

IN.0V2.description: Input 0 V, second diagram clamp; factory linked to IN.0V1.

OUT.+.description: Output +10 V relative to output zero; + marking.

OUT.0a.description: Upper output 0 in circuit diagram; alias a is not a physical number.

OUT.0b.description: Lower output 0 in circuit diagram; factory linked to OUT.0a.

OUT.-.description: Output -10 V relative to output zero; minus marking.
